## `neuro.atomics.load`

Static method on `Atomics`.

> Returns the value at the given position in the array. Until this atomic operation completes,
> any other read or write operation against the array will block.

## Signatures

```ts
load(input: { typedArray: Int8Array | Uint8Array | Int16Array | Uint16Array | Int32Array | Uint32Array; index: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
load(input: { typedArray: BigInt64Array | BigUint64Array; index: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<bigint>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Atomics.load` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
